import pytest
from semverrange import satisfies


# Version parsing and validation

class TestVersionValidation:
    """Test version parsing and validation."""

    def test_valid_simple_versions(self):
        """Test valid basic versions."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "0.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("100.200.300", "100.200.300")

    def test_valid_version_with_leading_v(self):
        """Test versions with leading v."""
        assert satisfies("v1.2.3", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "v1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("v1.2.3", "v1.2.3")

    def test_valid_version_with_whitespace(self):
        """Test versions with surrounding whitespace."""
        assert satisfies("  1.2.3  ", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "  1.2.3  ")

    def test_valid_prerelease_versions(self):
        """Test valid prerelease versions."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha.1", "1.0.0-alpha.1")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-0.3.7", "1.0.0-0.3.7")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-x.7.z.92", "1.0.0-x.7.z.92")

    def test_valid_build_metadata(self):
        """Test that build metadata is ignored."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+build", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3+build")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+build1", "1.2.3+build2")

    def test_prerelease_and_build(self):
        """Test versions with both prerelease and build."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha+build", "1.0.0-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha+build1", "1.0.0-alpha+build2")

    def test_invalid_version_missing_patch(self):
        """Test that incomplete versions raise ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_missing_minor(self):
        """Test that incomplete versions raise ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_leading_zero_major(self):
        """Test that leading zeros in major raise ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("01.2.3", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_leading_zero_minor(self):
        """Test that leading zeros in minor raise ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.02.3", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_leading_zero_patch(self):
        """Test that leading zeros in patch raise ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.03", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_leading_zero_prerelease(self):
        """Test that leading zeros in prerelease numeric identifiers raise ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3-01", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_missing_prerelease_identifier(self):
        """Test that missing prerelease identifier raises ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3-", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_too_many_parts(self):
        """Test that versions with too many parts raise ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3.4", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_non_numeric(self):
        """Test that non-numeric versions raise ValueError."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("a.b.c", "*")


# Version comparison

class TestVersionComparison:
    """Test version ordering and comparison."""

    def test_major_comparison(self):
        """Test that major version is compared first."""
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">=1.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", ">2.0.0")

    def test_minor_comparison(self):
        """Test that minor version is compared second."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", ">=1.1.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.0", ">1.2.0")

    def test_patch_comparison(self):
        """Test that patch version is compared third."""
        assert satisfies("1.1.2", ">=1.1.1")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.1", ">1.1.2")

    def test_prerelease_less_than_release(self):
        """Test that prerelease versions are lower than release versions."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<1.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", "<1.0.0-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<=1.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_comparison_numeric_vs_string(self):
        """Test that numeric identifiers are compared before string identifiers."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-1", "<1.0.0-alpha")

    def test_prerelease_comparison_numeric_order(self):
        """Test that numeric prerelease identifiers are compared numerically."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-2", ">1.0.0-10")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-10", ">1.0.0-2")

    def test_prerelease_comparison_string_order(self):
        """Test that non-numeric identifiers are compared in ASCII order."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<1.0.0-beta")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", ">1.0.0-alpha")

    def test_prerelease_comparison_fewer_identifiers_lower(self):
        """Test that fewer prerelease identifiers means lower version."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<1.0.0-alpha.1")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-alpha.1", "<1.0.0-alpha")

    def test_prerelease_complex_comparison(self):
        """Test complex prerelease comparisons."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha.1", "<1.0.0-alpha.beta")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha.beta", "<1.0.0-beta.2")


# Exact matching

class TestExactMatching:
    """Test exact version matching."""

    def test_exact_match_explicit_equals(self):
        """Test explicit = operator."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "=1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.4", "=1.2.3")

    def test_exact_match_no_operator(self):
        """Test implicit exact match."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.4", "1.2.3")

    def test_exact_match_ignores_build(self):
        """Test that exact match ignores build metadata."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+build1", "1.2.3+build2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+abc", "1.2.3")

    def test_exact_match_prerelease(self):
        """Test exact match with prerelease."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0-alpha")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "1.0.0-alpha")


# Comparison operators

class TestComparisonOperators:
    """Test primitive comparison operators."""

    def test_less_than(self):
        """Test < operator."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "<2.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "<2.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("3.0.0", "<2.0.0")

    def test_less_than_equal(self):
        """Test <= operator."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "<=2.0.0")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", "<=2.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("3.0.0", "<=2.0.0")

    def test_greater_than(self):
        """Test > operator."""
        assert satisfies("3.0.0", ">2.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", ">2.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", ">2.0.0")

    def test_greater_than_equal(self):
        """Test >= operator."""
        assert satisfies("3.0.0", ">=2.0.0")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">=2.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", ">=2.0.0")

    def test_operators_with_whitespace(self):
        """Test that operators can be followed by whitespace."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "> 1.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", ">= 1.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "< 2.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "<= 2.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "= 1.5.0")

    def test_operators_with_prerelease(self):
        """Test operators with prerelease versions."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", ">1.0.0-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", ">=1.0.0-alpha")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", ">1.0.0")


# X-ranges and partial versions

class TestXRangesAndPartialVersions:
    """Test X-ranges and partial version handling."""

    def test_star_range(self):
        """Test * range matches any version."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "*")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "*")
        assert satisfies("100.200.300", "100.200.300")

    def test_x_range(self):
        """Test x range matches any version."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "x")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "x")

    def test_uppercase_x_range(self):
        """Test X range matches any version."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "X")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "X")

    def test_empty_range(self):
        """Test empty range matches any version."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "")

    def test_x_minor_range(self):
        """Test 1.x matches >=1.0.0 <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "1.x")
        assert satisfies("1.5.7", "1.x")
        assert satisfies("1.999.999", "1.x")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "1.x")
        assert not satisfies("0.9.9", "1.x")

    def test_shorthand_minor_range(self):
        """Test 1 is shorthand for 1.x."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "1")
        assert satisfies("1.5.7", "1")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "1")

    def test_x_patch_range(self):
        """Test 1.2.x matches >=1.2.0 <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "1.2.x")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "1.2.x")
        assert satisfies("1.2.999", "1.2.x")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "1.2.x")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.9", "1.2.x")

    def test_shorthand_patch_range(self):
        """Test 1.2 is shorthand for 1.2.x."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "1.2")

    def test_gt_x_minor(self):
        """Test >1.x matches >=2.0.0."""
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">1.x")
        assert satisfies("3.0.0", ">1.x")
        assert not satisfies("1.9.9", ">1.x")

    def test_gt_x_patch(self):
        """Test >1.2.x (or >1.2) matches >=1.3.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.3.0", ">1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.4.0", ">1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.9", ">1.2")

    def test_gte_partial_version(self):
        """Test >=1.2 matches >=1.2.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", ">=1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.3.0", ">=1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.9", ">=1.2")

    def test_lt_x_minor(self):
        """Test <1.2.x matches <1.2.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.1.9", "<1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.1.0", "<1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.0", "<1.2")

    def test_lte_x_minor(self):
        """Test <=1.2.x matches <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.9", "<=1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "<=1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.1.0", "<=1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "<=1.2")

    def test_lte_x_major(self):
        """Test <=1 matches <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "<=1")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "<=1")
        assert satisfies("0.9.9", "<=1")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "<=1")

    def test_gt_star_matches_nothing(self):
        """Test >* matches nothing."""
        assert not satisfies("0.0.0", ">*")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.3", ">*")

    def test_lt_star_matches_nothing(self):
        """Test <* matches nothing."""
        assert not satisfies("0.0.0", "<*")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.3", "<*")


# Tilde ranges

class TestTildeRanges:
    """Test tilde (~) range syntax."""

    def test_tilde_patch_range(self):
        """Test ~1.2.3 matches >=1.2.3 <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "~1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.4", "~1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.999", "~1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "~1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.9", "~1.2.3")

    def test_tilde_minor_range(self):
        """Test ~1.2 matches >=1.2.0 <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "~1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "~1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.999", "~1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "~1.2")

    def test_tilde_major_range(self):
        """Test ~1 matches >=1.0.0 <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "~1")
        assert satisfies("1.5.7", "~1")
        assert satisfies("1.999.999", "~1")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "~1")

    def test_tilde_with_prerelease(self):
        """Test ~1.2.3-beta.2 matches >=1.2.3-beta.2 <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-beta.2", "~1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.4", "~1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.999", "~1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "~1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.3-beta.1", "~1.2.3-beta.2")


# Caret ranges

class TestCaretRanges:
    """Test caret (^) range syntax."""

    def test_caret_with_nonzero_major(self):
        """Test ^1.2.3 matches >=1.2.3 <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "^1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "^1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.999.999", "^1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.2", "^1.2.3")

    def test_caret_with_zero_major_nonzero_minor(self):
        """Test ^0.2.3 matches >=0.2.3 <0.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("0.2.3", "^0.2.3")
        assert satisfies("0.2.4", "^0.2.3")
        assert satisfies("0.2.999", "^0.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("0.3.0", "^0.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("0.2.2", "^0.2.3")

    def test_caret_with_zero_major_zero_minor(self):
        """Test ^0.0.3 matches >=0.0.3 <0.0.4-0."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.3", "^0.0.3")
        assert not satisfies("0.0.4", "^0.0.3")
        assert not satisfies("0.1.0", "^0.0.3")

    def test_caret_with_prerelease_nonzero_major(self):
        """Test ^1.2.3-beta.2 matches >=1.2.3-beta.2 <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-beta.2", "^1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "^1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1.2.3-beta.2")

    def test_caret_with_prerelease_zero_major_zero_minor(self):
        """Test ^0.0.3-beta matches >=0.0.3-beta <0.0.4-0."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.3-beta", "^0.0.3-beta")
        assert not satisfies("0.0.4", "^0.0.3-beta")

    def test_caret_x_nonzero_major(self):
        """Test ^1.2.x matches >=1.2.0 <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "^1.2.x")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "^1.2.x")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1.2.x")

    def test_caret_shorthand_patch(self):
        """Test ^1.2 matches >=1.2.0 <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "^1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "^1.2")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1.2")

    def test_caret_x_zero_major_zero_minor(self):
        """Test ^0.0.x matches >=0.0.0 <0.1.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "^0.0.x")
        assert satisfies("0.0.5", "^0.0.x")
        assert not satisfies("0.1.0", "^0.0.x")

    def test_caret_shorthand_zero_major_zero_minor(self):
        """Test ^0.0 matches >=0.0.0 <0.1.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "^0.0")
        assert satisfies("0.0.5", "^0.0")
        assert not satisfies("0.1.0", "^0.0")

    def test_caret_x_major(self):
        """Test ^1.x matches >=1.0.0 <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "^1.x")
        assert satisfies("1.5.7", "^1.x")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1.x")

    def test_caret_shorthand_major(self):
        """Test ^1 matches >=1.0.0 <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "^1")
        assert satisfies("1.5.7", "^1")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1")

    def test_caret_x_zero_major(self):
        """Test ^0.x matches >=0.0.0 <1.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "^0.x")
        assert satisfies("0.5.7", "^0.x")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", "^0.x")

    def test_caret_shorthand_zero_major(self):
        """Test ^0 matches >=0.0.0 <1.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "^0")
        assert satisfies("0.5.7", "^0")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", "^0")


# Hyphen ranges

class TestHyphenRanges:
    """Test hyphen (-) range syntax."""

    def test_hyphen_exact_to_exact(self):
        """Test 1.2.3 - 2.3.4 matches >=1.2.3 <=2.3.4."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")
        assert satisfies("2.3.4", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.2", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")
        assert not satisfies("2.3.5", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")

    def test_hyphen_partial_to_exact(self):
        """Test 1.2 - 2.3.4 matches >=1.2.0 <=2.3.4."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "1.2 - 2.3.4")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "1.2 - 2.3.4")
        assert satisfies("2.3.4", "1.2 - 2.3.4")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.9", "1.2 - 2.3.4")

    def test_hyphen_exact_to_partial(self):
        """Test 1.2.3 - 2.3 matches >=1.2.3 <2.4.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3 - 2.3")
        assert satisfies("2.3.9", "1.2.3 - 2.3")
        assert not satisfies("2.4.0", "1.2.3 - 2.3")

    def test_hyphen_exact_to_major_only(self):
        """Test 1.2.3 - 2 matches >=1.2.3 <3.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3 - 2")
        assert satisfies("2.5.7", "1.2.3 - 2")
        assert not satisfies("3.0.0", "1.2.3 - 2")


# Comparator sets

class TestComparatorSets:
    """Test comparator sets (space-separated comparators)."""

    def test_multiple_comparators_all_match(self):
        """Test that all comparators in a set must match."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0")

    def test_multiple_comparators_one_fails(self):
        """Test that if one comparator fails, the set fails."""
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("0.9.9", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0")

    def test_tilde_with_explicit_upper_bound(self):
        """Test tilde combined with explicit upper bound."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "~1.2.3 <1.3.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "~1.2.3 <1.3.0")

    def test_caret_with_explicit_upper_bound(self):
        """Test caret combined with explicit upper bound."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "^1.2.3 <2.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1.2.3 <2.0.0")


# Unions

class TestUnions:
    """Test union (||) syntax."""

    def test_union_first_matches(self):
        """Test that union succeeds if first set matches."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "1.0.0 || 2.0.0")

    def test_union_second_matches(self):
        """Test that union succeeds if second set matches."""
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", "1.0.0 || 2.0.0")

    def test_union_neither_matches(self):
        """Test that union fails if neither set matches."""
        assert not satisfies("1.5.0", "1.0.0 || 2.0.0")

    def test_union_multiple_sets(self):
        """Test union with more than two sets."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "0.5.0 || 1.0.0 || 2.0.0")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", "0.5.0 || 1.0.0 || 2.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.5.0", "0.5.0 || 1.0.0 || 2.0.0")

    def test_union_with_ranges(self):
        """Test union of range expressions."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "^1.0.0 || ^2.0.0")
        assert satisfies("2.5.0", "^1.0.0 || ^2.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("3.0.0", "^1.0.0 || ^2.0.0")

    def test_union_with_comparator_sets(self):
        """Test union with comparator sets."""
        assert satisfies("3.0.0", "1.x || >=3.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "1.x || >=3.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "1.x || >=3.0.0")


# Prerelease rules

class TestPrereleaseRules:
    """Test prerelease version matching rules."""

    def test_prerelease_matches_prerelease_comparator_same_base(self):
        """Test that prerelease version matches comparator with same MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha.7", ">1.2.3-alpha.3")

    def test_prerelease_no_match_different_base_version(self):
        """Test that prerelease doesn't match when base version differs."""
        assert not satisfies("3.4.5-alpha.9", ">1.2.3-alpha.3")

    def test_prerelease_no_match_star(self):
        """Test that prerelease doesn't match *."""
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "*")

    def test_prerelease_no_match_range_without_prerelease(self):
        """Test that prerelease doesn't match range without prerelease of same base."""
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "<2.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_matches_explicit_prerelease_comparator(self):
        """Test that prerelease matches explicit prerelease comparator."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", ">=1.0.0-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "1.0.0-beta")

    def test_prerelease_no_match_range_expansion_prerelease(self):
        """Test that prerelease may match -0 bounds from expansion."""
        # <1.2 expands to <1.2.0-0, which has a prerelease
        assert satisfies("1.1.9", "<1.2")
        # But 1.0.0-beta doesn't match <2.0.0 even though it's less
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "<2.0.0")

    def test_release_matches_any_range(self):
        """Test that release versions match ranges without special rules."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "*")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "<2.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "^1.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_in_comparator_set(self):
        """Test prerelease rule with comparator sets."""
        # 1.2.3-beta matches >=1.2.3-alpha because set contains comparator with same base
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-beta", ">=1.2.3-alpha")

    def test_release_versions_in_prerelease_range(self):
        """Test that release versions don't need matching prerelease."""

        assert satisfies("0.0.3", "^0.0.3-beta")
